title: Overtime

mood.label: Heavy going
mood.summary: Heavy going (39): Wall Street fell 3.7% as AI stocks cracked, missiles flew at Riyadh and over Poland, and COP31 ran into overtime on a draft without fossil fuels. Lighter notes: no injuries from Peru's quake, a French court's verdict on racist police.

lines: The screens went red at the opening bell,
three-point-seven, then five on the tech,
the fear gauge climbing past thirty-six,
and even the gold came down a step.
Three lights over Riyadh, caught in the dark,
Warsaw calling it what it is,
the climate room running into overtime,
a draft that no longer says the word for oil.
Peru shook hard and no one fell,
a court in France said what was done,
and on a Tuesday someone cooks for a hundred.
